newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble edges down, trade calm on U.S. holiday.
newsitem.headline: Rouble edges down, trade calm on U.S. holiday.

text.p: The rouble edged down on Monday tracking the central bank's rates, but dealers said trading was calm due to Martin Luther King partial holiday in the United States.
Russian banks use their U.S. counterparties for settlement.
roubles/dollar Jan 20 midday Jan 20 early Jan 17 close
"It is a typical Monday -- roubles are cheap and the dollar is two points higher in line with the central bank's rates," United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said.
Another dealer said trading was less active as banks were unable to arbitrage between different settlement dates.
